messages.content: Hi, my company wants 60 one-kg kaju katli gift boxes delivered to our office in Ludhiana next Friday.

Sure, 60 × 1 kg Kaju Katli boxes would be about 60 kg of sweet.  
- Kaju Katli: 60 kg × ₹1,100 = ₹66,000  
- 1 kg gift‑box packing: 60 × ₹80 = ₹4,800  
Estimated total: **≈ ₹70,800** (prices may vary during festivals; the team will confirm the final amount).  

Since this is a bulk order (over 5 kg and more than 20 boxes), we need at least 2 days’ notice, which you have.  

Could you please share:  
1. Your full name and WhatsApp (or phone) number?  
2. The exact delivery address of your office in Ludhiana?
My name is Neha Arora, company Arora Textiles, WhatsApp +91 98765 43210. Please deliver to the Arora Textiles office in Ludhiana; your team can take the exact address on WhatsApp.
Thank you, Neha. I have the company name and your WhatsApp number. Could you please provide the exact office address in Ludhiana and the preferred delivery time on Friday 16 October 2026?
I don't have the exact address handy, your team can take it on WhatsApp. No specific time, any time on Friday is fine.

Here’s a summary of your request:

- 60 × 1 kg Kaju Katli gift boxes (custom printed for Arora Textiles)  
- Delivery: Arora Textiles office, Ludhiana (exact address to be shared on WhatsApp)  
- Date needed: Friday 16 October 2026, any time  
- Contact: WhatsApp (+91 98765 43210)

Shall I send this to the Mehra Sweets team?
The Mehra Sweets team will contact you on WhatsApp shortly to confirm the order and final price.
